_about: T-594 (DAEMONS vision 9.36), written by DAEMONS tools/gensongs.py through companion_export.py -- never edit by hand. parts: a form's own part of its line's song (notes [midi, beats, the share of the part at which it is learned], bass [midi, beats], bpm, its key, and the levels it is learned between: from, the level its form begins, to, the level it is perfect at). songs: a species' song, its line's forms oldest first. window: how much of its part static takes to close on a note; static: its candidates, steps along the key from the true note, the first kept longest, and its hiss. Every note DRAFT.

CONTENT.name: C major
CONTENT.why: every white key and nothing added: the undifferentiated

CONTEXT.name: A minor
CONTEXT.why: CONTENT's seven notes heard from another centre: its relative minor

VECTOR.name: D-flat major
VECTOR.why: red into orange: sanguine, the arrow

ENTROPY.name: E-flat minor
ENTROPY.why: orange into yellow: choleric, the flicker

LATENT.name: B-flat minor
LATENT.why: indigo into violet: melancholic, something waking

FLOW.name: A-flat major
FLOW.why: blue into indigo: deep, moving, running down

LOGIC.name: G minor
LOGIC.why: steel blue: a proof, the key of the fugue

SWARM.name: E major
SWARM.why: yellow, olive: many small bright things

STRATUM.name: D major
STRATUM.why: orange-brown, the ground: the key of the open strings

LEGACY.name: D minor
LEGACY.why: the old modes: slate, the cairn

SIGNAL.name: F-sharp major
SIGNAL.why: green into blue, a carrier: every sharp lit

OPAQUE.name: B minor
OPAQUE.why: violet, the last colour before the light goes off

ORACLE.name: B major
ORACLE.why: violet into the carry: the one with no record
